access: Open Access; PhysioNet publishes anonymous wget and no-sign-request S3 acquisition.

acquisition.route: anonymous S3 prefix listing and GET
acquisition.selected_files: R04, R08, R12 EDF for every available subject S001-S109; all 109 had all three selected runs
acquisition.s3_etag_note: all selected-object ETags were 32-character MD5 digests and were verified against downloaded payloads

architecture_and_task_fit.task: binary supervised motor imagery classification on run 4/8/12 trials: T1=imagined left fist, T2=imagined right fist, T0=rest discarded
architecture_and_task_fit.representation: For each T1/T2 event with duration at least four seconds, take first four seconds from annotation onset, 64 channels; resample 160 Hz signals to 128 Hz with polyphase 4/5 conversion; keep native 128 Hz otherwise; flatten 64x512 samples into 32768 numeric features.
architecture_and_task_fit.preprocessing: channel-wise mean/std fitted only from training-subject windows; no learned feature extractor or non-MLP architecture.
architecture_and_task_fit.subject_split: subject-disjoint train/validation/test; deterministic shuffled subject IDs using NumPy default_rng seed 20261023; 76/16/17 subjects.

pilot.batching: entire training partition in one batch per epoch
pilot.decision: KEEP PROVISIONALLY: all three representative MLPs are unsaturated on the subject-held-out test split and clearly exceed 50% chance; test accuracy/macro-F1 0.800/0.800, 0.805/0.805 and 0.814/0.814 for [16,16], [128,128] and [512]*5. Generalization is plausible on this one split, but evidence is only one seed/split and three architectures.

limitations: Only the imagined left-vs-right task on runs 4/8/12 was evaluated.
One subject-disjoint split and seed; 17 held-out test subjects.
Only three representative vanilla architectures; no full vanilla grid or ADP-variant pilot.
A subset of source files uses 128 Hz while most use 160 Hz; explicit anti-aliased resampling was applied to obtain consistent feature width.
